entries.1a4b75b1470206c8: The annual securities report lists products by field, centered on AmiVoice. For call centers there are 'AmiVoice Communication Suite' and the voicebot 'AmiVoice ISR Studio'; for meeting minutes and transcription, 'VoXT One', 'ScribeAssist' and 'ProVoXT'; for medical use, the 'AmiVoice Ex7' series and 'AmiVoice iNote'; for manufacturing and logistics, the voice-picking system 'AmiVoice iPicking'; for sales and business negotiations, 'AmiVoice SalesBoost'; for construction and real estate, 'AmiVoice Super Inspection Platform' and 'AmiVoice B-Work One'; and for businesses that want to incorporate speech recognition, 'AmiVoice Cloud Platform' (API and SDK). The annual securities report's 'Material Contracts' section also lists a technology licensing agreement. The development and cross-license agreement with Solventum Health Information Systems, Inc. is printed as an agreement granting the company 'the exclusive right to create and sell Japanese speech recognition products and services incorporating the speech recognition technology of Multimodal Technologies, LLC (MTL)'; there is also a supplementary agreement under which the license fee for the ten years from October 1, 2025 to September 30, 2035 is paid in advance in a lump sum. The annual securities report does not state which part of the current AmiVoice this technology corresponds to.

entries.28247a5f8d79b61a: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,440 million (¥1,442 million in the prior-year period), a 0.2% decrease year on year. BSR1's operating profit before consolidation adjustments fell 1.1% to ¥1,503 million due to higher cost of sales and investment in personnel and development, while BSR2 posted an operating loss of ¥62 million, and its deficit narrowed. Ordinary profit was ¥1,558 million (up 1.2%), and the annual securities report attributes this to factors including higher interest income and increased foreign exchange gains. Net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥1,739 million (¥1,408 million in the prior-year period, up 23.5%), and the annual securities report attributes this to, among other things, the recording of gain on sale of investment securities. R&D expenses were ¥681 million, and the report states that the company also worked on full-scale operation of its data center and on strengthening its R&D structure in the field of generative AI.

entries.354f8a0c02598ac7: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,063 million (¥6,665 million in the prior-year period), a 6.0% increase year on year and a record high. Orders received were ¥7,225 million (year-on-year index of 106.3), and order backlog at period-end was ¥2,506 million (year-on-year index of 106.9). By field, the MD&A prints BSR1's revenue before consolidation adjustments as ¥6,217 million (up 4.6%) and BSR2's revenue, also before consolidation adjustments, as ¥911 million (up 19.5%). These are figures before consolidation adjustments, and they do not add up to consolidated revenue (the breakdown of the adjustments is not printed in the annual securities report). BSR1's stock revenue was ¥4,973 million (up 12.2%), and its stock ratio was 80.0%. The risk section of the annual securities report states that the audio business consists of “flow business,” such as product sales and solutions business, and “stock business,” such as subscription services, and that because shipments and acceptances in flow business are concentrated in September and March each year, revenue tends to be skewed toward the second and fourth quarters. The definition of “stock” is not printed in the annual securities report.

entries.42f641eebbe2263e: Advanced Media, Inc. and its three [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] (AMIVOICE THAI CO., LTD., Sokki Center Tsukuba Co., Ltd., and Amisapo Co., Ltd.) operate a single [[term:segment|segment]] in the voice business (as of March 31, 2026). The annual securities report states its vision as 'realizing HCI (Human Communication Integration)', aiming to open the 'era of soft communication', in which people can naturally convey their intentions to computers and AI. Consolidated employees numbered 286, and in addition there are temporary employees averaging 39 over the year. The business is divided into existing core business as BSR1 (first growth engine) and new business creation, M&A and overseas business as BSR2 (second growth engine), and is composed of eight profit units.

(Kingdom of Thailand) and Sokki Center Tsukuba Co., Ltd. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue before consolidation adjustments was ¥911 million (up 19.5% from the same period of the previous year) and operating loss was ¥62 million, with the loss narrowing. The BDC Division increased the number of licenses for its construction process management platform service (cumulative 85,932) and also grew its staffing services against the background of labor shortages in the construction industry, with higher revenue and lower profit due to an increase in selling, general and administrative expenses. The Overseas Business Division increased revenue substantially owing to higher use by a large customer; AMIVOICE THAI also increased revenue and narrowed its loss; Sokki Center Tsukuba was level with the previous year in both revenue and profit; and Amisupo recorded a loss as it could not recover its upfront investment. The securities report's table by field prints the construction and real estate field as installed at 578 companies as of the end of March 2026.
entries.def4289cd9adfdf8: The category corresponding to the existing core business, consisting of 4 profit units of the Company: the CTI Division (for the contact center industry), the VoXT Division (assembly and meeting solutions), the Medical Division (for the healthcare industry) and the SDX Division (API/SDK; customer service and sales negotiation solutions; for the manufacturing and logistics industries). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue before consolidation adjustments was ¥6,217 million (up 4.6% from the same period of the previous year) and operating profit was ¥1,503 million (down 1.1% from the same period of the previous year). Of this, stock revenue was ¥4,973 million (up 12.2% from the same period of the previous year), and the stock ratio is 80.0% (the securities report does not state a definition of "stock"). By division, CTI, VoXT and Medical increased in revenue and SDX decreased; Medical increased in profit, while CTI, VoXT and SDX decreased in profit. The securities report's table by field prints the number of installations as of the end of March 2026 as 610 companies in the call center field, 3,176 facilities in the minutes and transcription field, and 20,032 facilities in the healthcare field.
entries.dff42e8d25c3fd4e: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] describes the company group as a single [[term:segment|segment]]: the voice business. Centered on the AI speech recognition 'AmiVoice', it provides offerings in three forms: as a service that customers use (Service Business), license sales of application products that incorporate it (Product Business), and planning, design and development of speech recognition solutions that incorporate it (Solution Business). Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,063 million (¥6,665 million in the prior-year period), an all-time high, up 6.0% year on year.

entries.f4a500170615b0d8: A business centered on the AI speech recognition "AmiVoice", and the sole segment of the Group. The securities report explains it as divided into three: the Service Business, which provides AmiVoice in a usage-based form; the Product Business, which sells licenses for application products incorporating AmiVoice; and the Solution Business, which plans, designs and develops speech recognition solutions incorporating AmiVoice. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, consolidated revenue was ¥7,063 million (¥6,665 million in the previous year), up 6.0% from the previous year, the highest revenue on record. The business is defined with the existing core business as BSR1 (the first growth engine) and the creation of new businesses, M&A and overseas business as BSR2 (the second growth engine), and consists of 8 profit units. The Group consists of the Company and 3 consolidated subsidiaries (AMIVOICE THAI CO., LTD., Sokki Center Tsukuba Co., Ltd. and Amisupo Co., Ltd.). In April 2026, the Company acquired all shares of feat Co., Ltd. and made it a consolidated subsidiary, but this occurred after the end of the fiscal year (March 31, 2026) and is not included in these 3 companies.
